title: Grade 4 SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — General Assessment #9

pages.quiz:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why should fruits and vegetables be washed before eating? (1 mark)
   A. To remove dirt and germs
   B. To make them heavier
   C. To make them sweeter
   D. To make them hot

2. Which of these is a reason to conserve water? (1 mark)
   A. To make taps rust
   B. To make it more expensive
   C. To waste less time
   D. There will be enough for everyone

3. Which of these is opaque? (1 mark)
   A. Wood
   B. Clear plastic
   C. Clean water
   D. Clear glass

4. Why is it good to separate waste into different bins? (1 mark)
   A. It makes waste heavier
   B. It makes waste smell
   C. It makes reusing, recycling and composting easier
   D. It makes waste burn

5. Which of these will make a block slide the shortest distance on a ramp? (1 mark)
   A. Glass
   B. Oiled plastic
   C. Smooth tile
   D. Sandpaper

6. What is rainwater harvesting? (1 mark)
   A. Digging wells
   B. Catching and storing rainwater
   C. Selling rainwater
   D. Drinking rainwater from puddles

7. Ostrich and flamingo belong to which group? (1 mark)
   A. Birds
   B. Amphibians
   C. Reptiles
   D. Mammals

8. Which of these is a correct grouping? (1 mark)
   A. Milk, water and juice are liquids
   B. Steam, oil and rice are gases
   C. Air, stone and salt are gases
   D. Chalk, water and steam are solids

9. Why should you keep drinking water in a clean covered container? (1 mark)
   A. To keep it safe from germs
   B. To make it hot
   C. To make it salty
   D. To make it colder

10. Which of these is NOT a way to conserve water? (1 mark)
   A. Using a basin
   B. Harvesting rainwater
   C. Fixing leaks
   D. Washing dishes under a running tap

11. A bat flies but has fur and feeds its babies milk. What is it? (1 mark)
   A. A reptile
   B. An insect
   C. A mammal
   D. A bird

12. Which of these breaks down and rots easily? (1 mark)
   A. Glass bottle
   B. Tin can
   C. Plastic bag
   D. Vegetable peelings

13. A wheelbarrow is easier to move than dragging a load because (1 mark)
   A. The wheel reduces friction
   B. The load gets smaller
   C. Gravity is less
   D. The wheel is heavy

14. Why is cooking food useful? (1 mark)
   A. It makes food soft and safer to eat
   B. It makes food dirty
   C. It makes food cold
   D. It makes food raw

15. Which group of vertebrates feeds its young on milk? (1 mark)
   A. Mammals
   B. Fish
   C. Birds
   D. Reptiles

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Name the three main sources of heat. (2 marks)

17. Name three gases and say how each is useful. (3 marks)

18. Explain how ball bearings help a bicycle move. (4 marks)

19. Name the two forces studied in this topic. (2 marks)

20. Compare solids, liquids and gases in terms of shape and volume. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — To remove dirt and germs
   Washing removes dirt, germs and worm eggs.

2. D — There will be enough for everyone
   Conserving leaves water for others.

3. A — Wood
   Wood blocks light.

4. C — It makes reusing, recycling and composting easier
   Sorting helps each type be managed properly.

5. D — Sandpaper
   Rough surfaces have the most friction.

6. B — Catching and storing rainwater
   Harvesting means collecting rainwater from roofs.

7. A — Birds
   Both have feathers and lay eggs.

8. A — Milk, water and juice are liquids
   Milk, water and juice are all liquids.

9. A — To keep it safe from germs
   Covered clean containers protect water.

10. D — Washing dishes under a running tap
   A running tap wastes water.

11. C — A mammal
   The fur and milk feeding make it a mammal.

12. D — Vegetable peelings
   Vegetable peelings are decomposable.

13. A — The wheel reduces friction
   Wheels roll and reduce friction.

14. A — It makes food soft and safer to eat
   Heat kills many germs.

15. A — Mammals
   Mammals feed their babies with milk.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: The sun, fire and electricity.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two and 2 marks for all three.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Air or oxygen for breathing, cooking gas for cooking, air in tyres or footballs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each gas with its use.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: They are small steel balls in the wheel. They roll between moving parts, so there is less friction and the wheels turn easily.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for what they are, 1 mark for rolling, 1 mark for less friction, 1 mark for wheels turning easily.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Gravity and friction.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

20. (4 marks)
   Answer: Solid: own shape and fixed volume. Liquid: takes shape of container, fixed volume. Gas: no shape and no fixed volume, fills the container.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each state with correct shape and volume, plus 1 mark for a comparison.
